div.div:
Purpose
Make purpose, privacy obligations and lifecycle decisions explicit from collection through disposal.
Put into practice
• Record purpose, minimum necessary data and accountable owner.
• Define retention, archival, legal hold and deletion across sources, extracts, backups and derived assets.
• Route access, correction and deletion requests to accountable teams; record justified exceptions.
• Reassess purpose when data is reused; test end-to-end disposition and backup expiry.
Evidence
Purpose/use register · retention schedule · request workflow · disposition and exception records
Verify
Trace a test request across source, downstream and backup scopes; confirm completion evidence.

div.div:
Purpose
Keep critical data dependable through disruption and avoid unmanageable platform or provider dependency.
Put into practice
• Set business-approved recovery-time, recovery-point and availability objectives.
• Protect backups; exercise restoration and disaster recovery on a risk-based cadence.
• Validate recovered data for completeness, consistency and usability.
• Document dependencies, export formats, metadata and provider-exit steps for critical assets.
• Feed test failures and material supplier changes into the risk and funding backlog.
Evidence
Critical data-service register · recovery objectives · restore results · portability and exit plan
Verify
Restore a representative critical asset in isolation and demonstrate objectives and usable export.
